audit.source_question:
In the figure above if the area of triangle CAF is equal to the area of rectangle CDEF, what is the length of segment AD?
Choices:
A.7/2
B.5
C.7
D.15/2
E.15
audit.independent_solution: The rectangle area is 15·7=105. Triangle CAF has the same base CF=15 and area 105, so its altitude AC satisfies (1/2)·15·AC=105, giving AC=14. Thus AD=AC-CD=14-7=7, option C.
